question: Which solar lord is Rāma commanded to worship for victory?
premises: A command to worship is given.
The object of worship is Vivasvant.
He is identified as Bhāskara, lord of the worlds.
inference: Rāma is commanded to worship Vivasvant, Bhāskara, lord of the worlds.
plain_english: Worship Vivasvant, Bhāskara, the lord of the worlds.
